skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Interrogate a rough idea before any code gets written, one question at a time, until the plan has edges.

skills.name: acknowledge-project
skills.description: Absorb and confirm the current state of an existing project before proposing or changing anything.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Enforce red, green, refactor on every implementation task. A guardrail, active by default.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Review work against the plan between tasks and report issues by severity. A guardrail, active by default.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Find the root cause of a bug through a disciplined four-phase process instead of guessing.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Break an approved design into small, verifiable tasks an unsupervised agent can execute without drifting.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Verify work with evidence before declaring anything done. A guardrail, active by default.
